fund_name: iShares ESG Aware MSCI USA ETF
sustainability_rationale: Broad US large- and mid-cap exposure using an ESG-aware index with business-involvement screens including controversial weapons, tobacco, thermal coal and oil sands.
limitations: ESG-aware does not mean impact investing; methodology is relative to a parent index and may still include companies with material environmental or social controversies.

fund_name: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EAFE ETF
sustainability_rationale: Developed-market equity exposure outside the US and Canada with ESG characteristics and exclusions applied by the index methodology.
limitations: ESG scores are provider-dependent and the fund still carries currency, geographic and equity-market risk.
